To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present QCloud as an open source cloud-based system to perform automated quality control of data generated by mass spectrometry based proteomics laboratories, that is now publicly available and open for use.

we have developed an automated quality control system that is easy to use for any proteomics laboratory, it is based on a cloud infrastructure, it supports the most common proteomics workflows and data formats and it is publicly available.

QCloud is a user-friendly, open-source, web-based quality control platform that enables proteomics laboratories to monitor the quality of their data in real-time and compare it with data from other laboratories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a cloud-based quality control platform to support proteomics labs in their daily quality assessment.
the development of a cloud-based quality control platform to support mass spectrometry laboratories in their daily work, and to facilitate the assessment of the quality of acquired data.
the development of a cloud-based system for quality control in mass spectrometery-based proteomics laboratories.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

QCloud is a cloud-based quality control tool that supports the most common workflows in proteomics, it accepts data from all the major mass spectrometry vendors, it enables the annotation and reporting of incidences and it provides a user-friendly interface for daily quality control in proteomics laboratories.
this system is a valuable tool to support laboratories in daily quality assurance.
the QCloud system is a cloud-based quality control tool for mass spectrometric proteomics data, which can be used to support laboratories in the assessment of their analytical performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a system for proteomics laboratories to assess the quality of acquired data.
we have developed an open-source cloud-based system to enable the quality assessment of mass spectrometry data.
we have developed an open access cloud-based quality control tool for mass spectrometric proteomic data analysis, and it is available to the community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QCloud system can help to increase the efficiency and the quality of proteomics laboratories.

QCloud can be a useful tool to support proteomics labs with quality control and data processing, as well as to enable the comparison of different instruments and the identification of possible biases.
QCloud is the first cloud-based system that supports proteomics laboratories in the assessment of quality control of mass spectrometry data.
